question: A man walks east 3 km, then north 4 km, then west 6 km. How far is he from his starting point?
question_ne: एक जना मानिस पूर्व ३ किमी, त्यसपछि उत्तर ४ किमी, त्यसपछि पश्चिम ६ किमी हिँड्छ। ऊ सुरुको बिन्दुबाट कति टाढा छ?
explanation: Net east = 3 - 6 = -3 km, net north = 4 km. Distance = sqrt(-3^2 + 4^2) = sqrt(25) = 5 km.
explanation_ne: शुद्ध पूर्व = 3 - 6 = -3 किमी, शुद्ध उत्तर = 4 किमी हो। दूरी = sqrt(-3² + 4²) = sqrt(25) = 5 किमी हो।
source: Original practice question — Lok Sewa Prep Nepal
